_readme: The web's small nodes (23 Oct, Matt's 0.7.1 playtest): 108 still-lifes to art/nodes/, 64 px, the first manifest's style. The fillers are the last eight.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a scuffed white football with its panels gone grey, on a tuft of grass. Muted cool northern palette, worn, nothing new.
